//! Architecture syntax policy remains independent of active Cargo cfgs.
/// A real static alias, not a policy exemption.
type Label = &'static str;
type Duplicate = &'static str;
#[cfg(other)]
type Duplicate = &'static str;
#[custom]
type Opaque = &'static str;
type Wrapped = (&'static str);

/// The first doc comment is also the declaration span.
#[derive(Error, Copy)]
struct EdgeSource<'a, T, const N: usize> {
    file: Label,
    line: usize,
    shadow: T,
    duplicate: Duplicate,
    opaque: Opaque,
    wrapped: Wrapped,
    qualified: ::std::string::String,
    nested: Option<(&'a String, [u8; N])>,
    slice: [&'a String],
    pointer: *const &'a String,
    function: fn() -> String,
    assoc: <T as external::Trait>::Error,
    unqualified_assoc: <T>::Error,
    generic_args: GenericCopy<'a, N, Item = String>,
    function_trait: dyn Fn(u32) -> String,
}
#[derive(some::Copy)]
struct QualifiedCopy;
impl Copy for ManualCopy {}
struct ManualCopy;
#[derive(Error)]
enum RecordError {
    /// Variant docs count in the source span.
    Named { file: Label, value: QualifiedCopy },
    Pair(ManualCopy, &'static String),
    Empty,
}
#[cfg(test)]
struct IgnoredSource { message: String }
#[cfg(not(any()))]
#[derive(Error)]
struct InactiveSource { message: String }
impl std::error::Error for ManualError {}
struct ManualError { source: std::io::Error, file: Label, line: u32 }

impl EdgeSource<'_, (), 2> {
    /// Constructor docs are retained too.
    #[track_caller]
    #[custom::instrument(ret, skip(message), level = "trace")]
    fn new(message: String) -> Self { arbitrary().caller(); todo!() }
    #[tracing::instrument(ret(level = "trace"))]
    fn with_location(file: u32, x: &std::panic::Location) -> Self { todo!() }
    #[tracing::instrument(ret, bad =)]
    fn malformed_meta() -> Self { todo!() }
    #[tracing::instrument(field = Generic::<u8, u16>::new(), ret)]
    fn generic_meta() -> Self { todo!() }
    #[tracing::instrument(field = |x, y| x + y, ret)]
    fn closure_meta() -> Self { todo!() }
    fn ignored_receiver(&self) -> Self { todo!() }
    fn wrap(message: &str) -> Self { Self::new(AnotherKind::Edge(EdgeSource::new(message))) }
    fn semi(message: String) -> Self { EdgeSource::new(message); }
}
impl From<std::io::Error> for ManualError {
    #[track_caller]
    fn from(source: std::io::Error) -> Self { fn inner() { let _ = Location::caller; } todo!() }
}
trait Custom { fn method() { let _ = EdgeSource::new("trait"); } }
#[cfg(test)]
impl ManualError { fn nested() { let _ = EdgeSource::new("impl test still visited"); } }
fn extras() {
    let _ = AnotherKind::Edge((EdgeSource::new((r#"raw\text"#).to_owned())));
    let _ = EdgeSource::new("bare".to_string());
    let _ = EdgeSource::new(format!(("not a direct literal")));
    let _ = EdgeSource::new(format!("value, {}", 2));
    let _ = <ManualError as From<std::io::Error>>::from("qualified");
    let _ = action().map_err(<ManualError as From<std::io::Error>>::from);
    let _ = action().map_err((ManualError::from));
    let _ = action().map_err(|e| ManualError::from(e));
    opaque! { EdgeSource::new("not visited") }
    fn inner(message: &str) -> ManualError { Outer::new(OtherSource::new(message)) }
}
#[cfg(test)]
fn ignored() { let _ = EdgeSource::new("ignored"); }
mod aliases {
    type Label = &'static str;
    #[derive(Error)]
    struct Shadow<Label> { file: Label }
    #[derive(Error)]
    struct Nested { file: Label }
}
